author: New China TV
description: In Sandu, the only autonomous county of the Shui ethnic group in southwest China's Guizhou Province, tradition thunders to life as the grassroots "village horse racing" scene delivers a showstopper: women riders in vivid outfits galloping across the racecourse, loosing arrows with stunning precision. No easy mode, no compromise -- just speed, skill, and horsemanship on full display, turning the local venue into a living arena where culture, courage, and raw athleticism collide.
title: Village horse racing: women riders' "Mulan style" in SW China's Guizhou

author: New China TV
description: In Qujing city, southwest China's Yunnan Province, intelligent seeders powered by China's BeiDou navigation system run across fields, carving perfectly straight ridges with pinpoint accuracy. From soil prep to planting and harvest, this homegrown satellite tech is turning traditional agriculture into a fully automated, precision-driven operation, boosting efficiency, consistency, and control from start to finish.
title: BeiDou-powered intelligent seeders boost smart farming in SW China's Yunnan

author: New China TV
description: In Xinjiang's Altay region, power grid workers are going above and beyond, literally, using drones to "airlift" upgraded nesting homes for migratory birds near Ulunggur Lake. As flocks return each year, teams patrol 10kV to 110kV power lines, installing perches, artificial nests, and bird-safe guards to keep birds away from live wires. The result: fewer outages, safer grids, and thriving wildlife, proof that smart engineering can protect both infrastructure and nature in one sweep.
title: Drone airlifts artificial nests to protect birds & power lines in NW China's Xinjiang

description:
During China's May Day holiday, travelers in Wuhan left their luggage neatly lined up along subway station walls while they explored the city hands-free.
No guards. No chains. No worries about theft.
The scene amazed many online, with people calling Wuhan "a city full of warmth and trust."

Fashion, for him, is not just expression; it's a tool for urban renewal and hope. #EcoFashion
title: Ivorian designer uses eco-fashion to transform community image
